title: AD HOC COMMITTEE ON THE 2028 OLYMPICS AND PARALYMPIC GAMES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a request to LA28 to include in its legacy entity planning efforts…
text:
[Council File 15-0989-S80]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
AD HOC COMMITTEE ON THE 2028 OLYMPICS AND PARALYMPIC GAMES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a request to LA28 to include in its legacy entity planning efforts the continuation of youth sport subsidies similar to the Youth Sports Partnership.
Recommendation for Council action, as initiated by Motion (Rodriguez - Hernandez):
1. REQUEST the LA28 to include in their legacy entity planning efforts the continuation of youth sport subsidies similar to the Youth Sports Partnership.
2. INSTRUCT the Department of Recreation and Parks to report on the possible continuation of subsidies for youth sports programming subsequent to the conclusion of the PlayLA Youth Sports Partnership in 2028, including funding requirements and potential sources, including looking at potential for the legacy entity to support or endow it.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
